table.name: mv_tenant_feature_flags_cache
table.remarks: Materialized view for fast feature flag lookups with pre-computed evaluations
table.viewSql: WITH feature_evaluation AS ( SELECT ff.tenant_id, ff.id AS feature_flag_id, ff.name AS feature_flag_name, ff.flag_type, ff.default_value, ff.rollout_percentage, ff.target_audience, ff.metadata, tfo.enabled AS override_enabled, tfo.value AS override_value, tfo.reason AS override_reason, CASE WHEN (tfo.enabled IS NOT NULL) THEN tfo.enabled WHEN ((ff.rollout_percentage IS NOT NULL) AND (ff.rollout_percentage > 0)) THEN ((hashtext(((ff.tenant_id)::text || (ff.name)::text)) % 100) < ff.rollout_percentage) ELSE ff.default_value END AS effective_enabled, COALESCE(tfo.value, '{}'::jsonb) AS effective_value, CASE WHEN (tfo.enabled IS NOT NULL) THEN 'override'::text WHEN ((ff.rollout_percentage IS NOT NULL) AND (ff.rollout_percentage > 0)) THEN 'rollout'::text ELSE 'default'::text END AS evaluation_source, GREATEST(ff.updated_at, COALESCE(tfo.updated_at, ff.updated_at)) AS cache_timestamp FROM (feature_flags ff LEFT JOIN tenant_feature_overrides tfo ON (((ff.id = tfo.feature_flag_id) AND (tfo.tenant_id = ff.tenant_id)))) WHERE (ff.deleted_at IS NULL) ) SELECT tenant_id, feature_flag_id, feature_flag_name, flag_type, effective_enabled AS enabled, effective_value AS value, evaluation_source, default_value, rollout_percentage, target_audience, metadata, override_enabled, override_value, override_reason, cache_timestamp, now() AS cache_created_at FROM feature_evaluation;

table.name: mv_user_effective_permissions
table.remarks: Pre-computed effective permissions for all users with optimized access patterns
table.viewSql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.tenant_id, r.id AS resource_id, a.id AS action_id, max( CASE WHEN ((up.effect)::text = 'DENY'::text) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS allow_flag, array_agg(DISTINCT rp.id) AS role_permission_ids, array_agg(DISTINCT up.id) AS direct_permission_ids FROM (((((users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON (((u.id = ur.user_id) AND (ur.is_active = true) AND ((ur.expires_at IS NULL) OR (ur.expires_at > now()))))) LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON (((ur.role_id = rp.role_id) AND (rp.is_active = true)))) LEFT JOIN user_permissions up ON (((u.id = up.user_id) AND (up.is_active = true) AND ((up.expires_at IS NULL) OR (up.expires_at > now()))))) JOIN resources r ON (((rp.permission_id = r.id) OR (up.permission_id = r.id)))) JOIN actions a ON (((rp.permission_id = a.id) OR (up.permission_id = a.id)))) GROUP BY u.id, u.tenant_id, r.id, a.id;

table.name: v_active_entities
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, e.uuid AS entity_id, e.name AS entity_name, e.type AS entity_type, e.code AS entity_code, c.name AS company_name, r.name AS regional_name, d.name AS department_name, e.is_active, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM ((((entities e JOIN tenants t ON ((e.tenant_id = t.id))) LEFT JOIN entities c ON ( CASE WHEN ((e.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text) THEN (e.uuid = c.uuid) ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy_paths hp WHERE ((hp.descendant_id = e.uuid) AND (hp.ancestor_id = c.uuid) AND ((c.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text)))) END)) LEFT JOIN entities r ON ( CASE WHEN ((e.type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGION'::character varying, 'REGIONAL'::character varying])::text[])) THEN (e.uuid = r.uuid) ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hierarchy_paths hp WHERE ((hp.descendant_id = e.uuid) AND (hp.ancestor_id = r.uuid) AND ((r.type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGION'::character varying, 'REGIONAL'::character varying])::text[]))))) END)) LEFT JOIN entities d ON ( CASE WHEN ((e.type)::text = 'DEPARTMENT'::text) THEN (e.uuid = d.uuid) ELSE ((e.parent_id = d.uuid) AND ((d.type)::text = 'DEPARTMENT'::text)) END)) WHERE ((e.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (e.is_active = true) AND ((c.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (c.uuid IS NULL)) AND ((r.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (r.uuid IS NULL)) AND ((d.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (d.uuid IS NULL)));

table.name: v_audit_summary_view
table.remarks: Hourly audit event summary for the last 7 days with risk metrics and access decision counts for security monitoring dashboards.
table.viewSql: SELECT tenant_id, event_category, severity, date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at) AS hour_bucket, count(*) AS event_count, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users, avg(risk_score) AS avg_risk_score, max(risk_score) AS max_risk_score, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((decision)::text = 'DENY'::text)) AS denied_attempts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((decision)::text = 'ALLOW'::text)) AS allowed_attempts FROM audit_log WHERE (created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) GROUP BY tenant_id, event_category, severity, (date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at)) ORDER BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at)) DESC, (count(*)) DESC;

table.name: v_chart_of_accounts_complete
table.remarks: Complete chart of accounts with full group and header hierarchy for reporting
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.tenant_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.account_description, a.root_type, a.account_type, a.account_subtype, a.account_category, a.normal_balance, a.current_balance, a.is_active, (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM finance_accounts children WHERE ((children.parent_account_id = a.id) AND (children.deleted_at IS NULL))))) AS is_leaf_account, a.parent_account_id, a.account_level, a.account_path, g.id AS group_id, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.group_category, g.group_path, h.id AS header_id, h.group_code AS header_code, h.group_name AS header_name, h.financial_statement_section, h.statement_order AS header_order, COALESCE(a.display_order, g.statement_order, h.statement_order, 999) AS display_order, COALESCE(h.financial_statement_section, g.financial_statement_section, ( CASE a.root_type WHEN 'ASSET'::text THEN 'Balance Sheet'::text WHEN 'LIABILITY'::text THEN 'Balance Sheet'::text WHEN 'EQUITY'::text THEN 'Balance Sheet'::text ELSE 'Income Statement'::text END)::character varying) AS statement_section, COALESCE(a.cash_flow_type, g.cash_flow_category, h.cash_flow_category) AS cash_flow_classification, (a.show_in_reports AND COALESCE(g.show_in_summary, true)) AS include_in_reports FROM ((finance_accounts a LEFT JOIN finance_account_groups g ON ((a.account_group_id = g.id))) LEFT JOIN finance_account_groups h ON ((a.account_header_id = h.id))) WHERE (a.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(h.statement_order, g.statement_order, 999), COALESCE(g.statement_order, 999), a.display_order, a.account_code;

table.name: v_company_structure
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, c.uuid AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.code AS company_code, e.uuid AS entity_id, e.name AS entity_name, e.type AS entity_type, e.code AS entity_code, hp.depth AS levels_from_company FROM (((entities c JOIN hierarchy_paths hp ON ((c.uuid = hp.ancestor_id))) JOIN entities e ON ((hp.descendant_id = e.uuid))) JOIN tenants t ON ((c.tenant_id = t.id))) WHERE (((c.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (e.deleted_at IS NULL));

table.name: v_cost_center_info
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, cc.uuid AS cost_center_id, cc.name AS cost_center, cc.code AS cost_center_code, d.uuid AS department_id, d.name AS department, r.uuid AS regional_id, r.name AS regional, c.uuid AS company_id, c.name AS company, cc.is_active AS cost_center_active, cc.created_at AS cost_center_created FROM ((((entities cc JOIN entities d ON ((cc.parent_id = d.uuid))) JOIN entities r ON ((d.parent_id = r.uuid))) JOIN entities c ON ((r.parent_id = c.uuid))) JOIN tenants t ON ((cc.tenant_id = t.id))) WHERE (((cc.type)::text = 'COST_CENTER'::text) AND ((d.type)::text = 'DEPARTMENT'::text) AND ((r.type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGION'::character varying, 'REGIONAL'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((c.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text) AND (cc.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (d.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL));

table.name: v_department_summary
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, d.uuid AS department_id, d.name AS department_name, d.code AS department_code, r.uuid AS regional_id, r.name AS regional_name, c.uuid AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, count(DISTINCT cc.uuid) AS cost_center_count, d.is_active AS department_active, d.created_at AS department_created FROM ((((entities d JOIN entities r ON ((d.parent_id = r.uuid))) JOIN entities c ON ((r.parent_id = c.uuid))) JOIN tenants t ON ((d.tenant_id = t.id))) LEFT JOIN entities cc ON (((cc.parent_id = d.uuid) AND ((cc.type)::text = 'COST_CENTER'::text) AND (cc.deleted_at IS NULL)))) WHERE (((d.type)::text = 'DEPARTMENT'::text) AND ((r.type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGION'::character varying, 'REGIONAL'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((c.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text) AND (d.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL)) GROUP BY t.id, t.name, d.uuid, d.name, d.code, d.is_active, d.created_at, r.uuid, r.name, c.uuid, c.name;

table.name: v_entity_changes
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, e.uuid AS entity_id, e.name AS entity_name, e.type AS entity_type, e.validation_status, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.deleted_at, CASE WHEN (e.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'DELETED'::text WHEN (e.updated_at > (e.created_at + '00:01:00'::interval)) THEN 'MODIFIED'::text ELSE 'CREATED'::text END AS change_type FROM (entities e JOIN tenants t ON ((e.tenant_id = t.id))) ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC;

table.name: v_entity_paths
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, a.uuid AS ancestor_id, a.name AS ancestor_name, a.type AS ancestor_type, d.uuid AS descendant_id, d.name AS descendant_name, d.type AS descendant_type, hp.depth FROM (((hierarchy_paths hp JOIN entities a ON ((hp.ancestor_id = a.uuid))) JOIN entities d ON ((hp.descendant_id = d.uuid))) JOIN tenants t ON ((hp.tenant_id = t.id))) WHERE ((a.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (d.deleted_at IS NULL)) ORDER BY hp.depth, a.name, d.name;

table.name: v_entity_structure
table.viewSql: SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, cc.uuid AS cost_center_id, cc.name AS cost_center, d.uuid AS department_id, d.name AS department, r.uuid AS regional_id, r.name AS regional, c.uuid AS company_id, c.name AS company FROM ((((entities cc JOIN entities d ON (((cc.parent_id = d.uuid) AND ((d.type)::text = 'DEPARTMENT'::text)))) JOIN entities r ON (((d.parent_id = r.uuid) AND ((r.type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGION'::character varying, 'REGIONAL'::character varying])::text[]))))) JOIN entities c ON (((r.parent_id = c.uuid) AND ((c.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text)))) JOIN tenants t ON ((cc.tenant_id = t.id))) WHERE (((cc.type)::text = 'COST_CENTER'::text) AND (cc.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (d.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL));

table.name: v_finance_account_activity
table.remarks: Account activity summary for monitoring and analysis
table.viewSql: SELECT a.tenant_id, a.id AS account_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.current_balance, a.last_transaction_date, count(e.id) AS total_entries, count( CASE WHEN (t.transaction_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '30 days'::interval)) THEN 1 ELSE NULL::integer END) AS entries_last_30_days, sum( CASE WHEN (t.transaction_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '30 days'::interval)) THEN e.debit_amount ELSE (0)::numeric END) AS debits_last_30_days, sum( CASE WHEN (t.transaction_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '30 days'::interval)) THEN e.credit_amount ELSE (0)::numeric END) AS credits_last_30_days FROM ((finance_accounts a LEFT JOIN finance_transaction_entries e ON ((a.id = e.account_id))) LEFT JOIN finance_transactions t ON (((e.transaction_id = t.id) AND ((t.transaction_status)::text = 'POSTED'::text)))) WHERE (a.deleted_at IS NULL) GROUP BY a.tenant_id, a.id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.current_balance, a.last_transaction_date;

table.name: v_finance_accounts_hierarchy
table.remarks: Hierarchical view of chart of accounts with computed paths and levels
table.viewSql: WITH RECURSIVE account_tree AS ( SELECT finance_accounts.id, finance_accounts.tenant_id, finance_accounts.account_code, finance_accounts.account_name, finance_accounts.parent_account_id, finance_accounts.root_type, finance_accounts.account_type, finance_accounts.normal_balance, finance_accounts.current_balance, 1 AS level, (finance_accounts.account_code)::character varying(500) AS full_path, (finance_accounts.account_name)::character varying(500) AS full_name FROM finance_accounts WHERE ((finance_accounts.parent_account_id IS NULL) AND (finance_accounts.deleted_at IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.parent_account_id, a.root_type, a.account_type, a.normal_balance, a.current_balance, (t.level + 1), ((((t.full_path)::text || '.'::text) || (a.account_code)::text))::character varying(500) AS "varchar", ((((t.full_name)::text || ' > '::text) || (a.account_name)::text))::character varying(500) AS "varchar" FROM (finance_accounts a JOIN account_tree t ON ((a.parent_account_id = t.id))) WHERE (a.deleted_at IS NULL) ), account_tree_with_children AS ( SELECT account_tree.id, account_tree.tenant_id, account_tree.account_code, account_tree.account_name, account_tree.parent_account_id, account_tree.root_type, account_tree.account_type, account_tree.normal_balance, account_tree.current_balance, account_tree.level, account_tree.full_path, account_tree.full_name FROM account_tree ) SELECT at.id, at.tenant_id, at.account_code, at.account_name, at.parent_account_id, at.root_type, at.account_type, at.normal_balance, at.current_balance, at.level, at.full_path, at.full_name, COALESCE(child_counts.child_count, (0)::bigint) AS child_count FROM (account_tree_with_children at LEFT JOIN ( SELECT finance_accounts.parent_account_id, count(*) AS child_count FROM finance_accounts WHERE (finance_accounts.deleted_at IS NULL) GROUP BY finance_accounts.parent_account_id) child_counts ON ((at.id = child_counts.parent_account_id)));

table.name: v_finance_accounts_with_groups
table.remarks: Complete account view with group and header information for reporting
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.account_description, a.root_type, a.account_type, a.account_category, a.normal_balance, a.current_balance, a.is_active, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.group_category, h.group_code AS header_code, h.group_name AS header_name, h.financial_statement_section, a.parent_account_id, a.account_level, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM finance_accounts children WHERE ((children.parent_account_id = a.id) AND (children.deleted_at IS NULL)))) AS has_children, (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM finance_accounts children WHERE ((children.parent_account_id = a.id) AND (children.deleted_at IS NULL))))) AS is_leaf_account, COALESCE(a.display_order, g.statement_order, 999) AS effective_display_order, a.cash_flow_type, a.show_in_reports FROM ((finance_accounts a LEFT JOIN finance_account_groups g ON ((a.account_group_id = g.id))) LEFT JOIN finance_account_groups h ON ((a.account_header_id = h.id))) WHERE (a.deleted_at IS NULL);

table.name: v_finance_transaction_summary
table.remarks: Summary view of transactions with entry counts and reconciliation status
table.viewSql: SELECT t.id, t.tenant_id, t.transaction_number, t.transaction_date, t.description, t.transaction_status, t.currency_code, t.total_debit_amount, t.total_credit_amount, count(e.id) AS entry_count, count(DISTINCT e.account_id) AS unique_accounts, bool_and(e.reconciled) AS all_entries_reconciled, string_agg(DISTINCT (a.account_code)::text, ', '::text ORDER BY (a.account_code)::text) AS account_codes FROM ((finance_transactions t LEFT JOIN finance_transaction_entries e ON ((t.id = e.transaction_id))) LEFT JOIN finance_accounts a ON ((e.account_id = a.id))) WHERE (t.deleted_at IS NULL) GROUP BY t.id, t.tenant_id, t.transaction_number, t.transaction_date, t.description, t.transaction_status, t.currency_code, t.total_debit_amount, t.total_credit_amount;

table.name: v_financial_statement_builder
table.remarks: Pre-aggregated data for building financial statements with grouping and totals
table.viewSql: WITH grouped_balances AS ( SELECT coa.tenant_id, coa.statement_section, coa.header_id, coa.header_code, coa.header_name, coa.header_order, coa.group_id, coa.group_code, coa.group_name, coa.group_category, count(coa.account_id) AS account_count, sum(coa.current_balance) AS group_balance, sum( CASE WHEN coa.is_active THEN coa.current_balance ELSE (0)::numeric END) AS active_balance FROM v_chart_of_accounts_complete coa WHERE (coa.include_in_reports = true) GROUP BY coa.tenant_id, coa.statement_section, coa.header_id, coa.header_code, coa.header_name, coa.header_order, coa.group_id, coa.group_code, coa.group_name, coa.group_category ) SELECT tenant_id, statement_section, header_code, header_name, header_order, group_code, group_name, group_category, account_count, group_balance, active_balance, sum(group_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, statement_section ORDER BY header_order, group_code) AS running_total, round(((group_balance / NULLIF(sum(group_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, statement_section), (0)::numeric)) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS percentage_of_section FROM grouped_balances ORDER BY statement_section, header_order, group_code;

table.name: v_financial_statement_structure
table.remarks: Financial statement structure with account groups, hierarchies, and balances
table.viewSql: SELECT g.id, g.tenant_id, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.root_type, g.financial_statement_section, g.statement_order, g.group_level, g.parent_group_id, g.show_in_summary, g.group_path, count(a.id) AS account_count, sum( CASE WHEN (a.is_active = true) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_account_count, COALESCE(sum(a.current_balance), (0)::numeric) AS group_balance FROM (finance_account_groups g LEFT JOIN finance_accounts a ON ((((a.account_group_id = g.id) OR (a.account_header_id = g.id)) AND (a.deleted_at IS NULL)))) WHERE (g.deleted_at IS NULL) GROUP BY g.id, g.tenant_id, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.root_type, g.financial_statement_section, g.statement_order, g.group_level, g.parent_group_id, g.show_in_summary, g.group_path ORDER BY g.financial_statement_section, g.statement_order, g.group_code;

table.name: v_role_permissions_summary
table.remarks: Summary view of roles with their permissions, resources, actions, and user assignment counts for role management and analysis.
table.viewSql: SELECT r.tenant_id, r.id AS role_id, r.name AS role_name, r.display_name AS role_display_name, r.role_type, r.level AS hierarchy_level, r.module_id, m.name AS module_name, array_agg(DISTINCT res.name ORDER BY res.name) FILTER (WHERE (res.name IS NOT NULL)) AS resource_names, array_agg(DISTINCT a.name ORDER BY a.name) FILTER (WHERE (a.name IS NOT NULL)) AS action_names, count(DISTINCT rp.permission_id) AS permission_count, count(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FILTER (WHERE (ur.is_active = true)) AS assigned_user_count FROM ((((((roles r LEFT JOIN modules m ON ((r.module_id = m.id))) LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON (((r.id = rp.role_id) AND (rp.is_active = true)))) LEFT JOIN permissions p ON (((rp.permission_id = p.id) AND (p.is_active = true)))) LEFT JOIN resources res ON (((p.resource_id = res.id) AND (res.is_active = true)))) LEFT JOIN actions a ON (((p.action_id = a.id) AND (a.is_active = true)))) LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON (((r.id = ur.role_id) AND (ur.is_active = true) AND ((ur.expires_at IS NULL) OR (ur.expires_at > now()))))) WHERE ((r.is_active = true) AND (r.deleted_at IS NULL)) GROUP BY r.tenant_id, r.id, r.name, r.display_name, r.role_type, r.level, r.module_id, m.name;

table.name: v_security_threat_dashboard
table.remarks: Identifies potential security threats through session anomalies and audit patterns
table.viewSql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email, count(s.id) FILTER (WHERE (s.risk_score > 70)) AS high_risk_sessions, max(s.risk_score) AS max_risk_score, count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE (a.risk_score > 80)) AS critical_events, max(a.created_at) AS last_suspicious_activity FROM ((users u LEFT JOIN user_sessions s ON ((u.id = s.user_id))) LEFT JOIN audit_log a ON (((u.id = a.user_id) AND (a.risk_score > 50)))) WHERE (((u.account_status)::text = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND ((s.risk_score > 50) OR (a.risk_score > 50))) GROUP BY u.id;

table.name: v_tenant_entity_summary
table.viewSql: SELECT t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, t.status AS tenant_status, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) AS total_entities, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE ((e.type)::text = 'COMPANY'::text)) AS company_count, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE ((e.type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REGION'::character varying, 'REGIONAL'::character varying])::text[]))) AS regional_count, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE ((e.type)::text = 'DEPARTMENT'::text)) AS department_count, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE ((e.type)::text = 'COST_CENTER'::text)) AS cost_center_count, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE ((e.type)::text = 'PROJECT'::text)) AS project_count, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE (e.is_active = true)) AS active_entities, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE (e.deleted_at IS NULL)) AS non_deleted_entities FROM (tenants t LEFT JOIN entities e ON ((e.tenant_id = t.id))) GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.status;

table.name: v_tenant_hierarchy
table.viewSql: WITH RECURSIVE org_chart AS ( SELECT e.uuid AS entity_id, e.name, e.type, e.parent_id, e.tenant_id, (e.name)::text AS path, 0 AS depth FROM entities e WHERE ((e.parent_id IS NULL) AND (e.deleted_at IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT e.uuid AS entity_id, e.name, e.type, e.parent_id, e.tenant_id, ((oc_1.path || ' > '::text) || (e.name)::text) AS text, (oc_1.depth + 1) FROM (entities e JOIN org_chart oc_1 ON ((e.parent_id = oc_1.entity_id))) WHERE (e.deleted_at IS NULL) ) SELECT t.name AS tenant_name, oc.entity_id, oc.name AS entity_name, oc.type AS entity_type, oc.path AS full_path, oc.depth FROM (org_chart oc JOIN tenants t ON ((oc.tenant_id = t.id)));

table.name: v_tenant_resource_utilization
table.viewSql: SELECT t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, t.status AS tenant_status, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) AS total_entities, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE (e.is_active = true)) AS active_entities, count(DISTINCT e.uuid) FILTER (WHERE (e.deleted_at IS NULL)) AS non_deleted_entities, count(DISTINCT es.uuid) AS sequence_states, count(DISTINCT es.key) AS document_types, max(e.created_at) AS last_entity_created, max(e.updated_at) AS last_entity_updated FROM ((tenants t LEFT JOIN entities e ON ((e.tenant_id = t.id))) LEFT JOIN entitystate es ON ((es.tenant_id = t.id))) GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.status;

table.name: v_user_complete_view
table.remarks: view combining user, person, and employee data with role aggregations and combined ABAC attributes for authorization decisions.
table.viewSql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.tenant_id, u.entity_id, u.username, u.email, u.user_type, u.account_status, u.is_active AS user_active, u.last_login_at, u.mfa_enabled, p.id AS person_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.middle_name, p.person_type, e.id AS employee_id, e.employee_number, e.position_title, e.department_id, e.employment_status, e.security_level, ((COALESCE(p.security_attributes, '{}'::jsonb) || COALESCE(e.access_attributes, '{}'::jsonb)) || COALESCE(u.user_attributes, '{}'::jsonb)) AS combined_attributes, array_agg(DISTINCT r.name ORDER BY r.name) AS role_names, array_agg(DISTINCT r.id ORDER BY r.id) AS role_ids, count(DISTINCT ur.id) FILTER (WHERE (ur.is_active = true)) AS active_role_count FROM ((((users u LEFT JOIN persons p ON ((u.person_id = p.id))) LEFT JOIN employees e ON ((u.employee_id = e.id))) LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON (((u.id = ur.user_id) AND (ur.is_active = true) AND ((ur.expires_at IS NULL) OR (ur.expires_at > now()))))) LEFT JOIN roles r ON (((ur.role_id = r.id) AND (r.is_active = true) AND (r.deleted_at IS NULL)))) WHERE (u.deleted_at IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.tenant_id, u.entity_id, u.username, u.email, u.user_type, u.account_status, u.is_active, u.last_login_at, u.mfa_enabled, p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.middle_name, p.person_type, e.id, e.employee_number, e.position_title, e.department_id, e.employment_status, e.security_level, p.security_attributes, e.access_attributes, u.user_attributes;
